subtitle: Cross-check of 24/Oct/2026, 20th day of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) and the eve of the vote: Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 24/Oct, 17:21 BRT, the forty-six national polls conducted after the vote, including the three released since the previous update (CNT/MDA, Colectta and Vetor Arrow), the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally and the press flow of 23 and 24/Oct.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 16.50% (cumulative volume USD 29.89M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 24/Oct, 17:21 BRT, falls 7.00pp against the confirmed reading of 23/Oct at 19:10 BRT, published in the previous update. BALLOT: 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLLS: ahead in Colectta of 24/Oct, 46.5% to 46%, and in the three Vox Brasil polls; behind in CNT/MDA of 24/Oct, 45% to 46.3%, and in Vetor Arrow of 23/Oct, 44.9% to 50%.
fortes: He leads Colectta of 24/Oct, with 46.5% to 46% in total votes and 50.3% of the valid votes, and the three Vox Brasil polls conducted after the vote: 45.4% to 44.3% on 23/Oct, 46.4% to 44.6% on 18/Oct and 44.2% to 42.7% on 09/Oct.
In Datafolha of 22/Oct he ties at 50% of the valid votes with Flávio Bolsonaro, who in the 15/Oct wave had 51% to 49%; in Ipespe/Abrapel, his rejection is 47%, against 48% for Flávio Bolsonaro.
🏆 Counting the closed contracts, his contract is still the one with the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 29.89M.
fracos: He stands at 16.50% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 24/Oct, 17:21 BRT, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over him is 67.20pp.
He trails in forty-one of the forty-six national polls conducted after the vote, among them CNT/MDA of 24/Oct, with 45% to 46.3%, and Vetor Arrow of 23/Oct, with 44.9% to 50%.
He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 1.87 points behind Flávio Bolsonaro, with 45.16% of the valid votes against 47.03%.
In Real Time Big Data of 23/Oct, 36% would never vote for him, against 33% who would never vote for Flávio Bolsonaro; in Ipespe/Abrapel, the government is disapproved by 47% and approved by 45%.
candidates.analise: Lula stands at 16.50% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 29.89M), confirmed reading of 24/Oct, 17:21 BRT, and falls 7.00pp against the confirmed reading of 23/Oct at 19:10 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). 📊 Three new national polls came out since the previous update. CNT/MDA, released on 24/Oct, with 2,002 in-person interviews from 21 to 23/Oct, gives 46.3% to Flávio Bolsonaro and 45% to Lula in total votes, with 5.8% blank or null and 2.9% undecided, and 50.7% to 49.3% in valid votes (CNN Brasil, Exame and BPMoney). Colectta, released on 24/Oct, with 3,000 in-person interviews on 23/Oct in 101 municipalities, gives 46.5% to Lula and 46% to Flávio Bolsonaro in total votes and 50.3% to 49.7% in valid votes (CartaCapital and Congresso em Foco). Vetor Arrow, released on 23/Oct, with 6,867 automated telephone interviews, gives 50% to Flávio Bolsonaro and 44.9% to Lula in total votes and 52.7% to 47.3% in valid votes (Rádio Corredor and Agenda do Poder). Against the pollster's previous wave, CNT/MDA goes from 46.8% to 45.9% to 46.3% to 45% in Flávio Bolsonaro's favour in total votes. On 22/Oct, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro signed at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) a document authorizing the lifting of their bank, tax and phone secrecy, and on 23/Oct the two campaigns delivered the authorizations, without disclosing the data (UOL and O Globo). On 24/Oct, the Electoral Prosecutor General's Office argued for dismissing the case on lifting the secrecy, on the view that it is not for the Electoral Court to decide on the disclosure (Gazeta do Povo, Folha de S.Paulo, Estadão and G1). After the promulgation, Lula said the 6x1 work schedule will return if Flávio Bolsonaro wins the election (O Globo and Valor), and on 13/Oct he announced Prospera MEI, with forgiveness of individual microentrepreneurs' debts estimated at R$ 12.6 billion (Poder360 and Estadão). ⚖️ On 20/Oct, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) asked the Supreme Court for more time in the inquiries into alleged influence peddling by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, the president's son, and Justice Edson Fachin is to decide (Estadão and G1). ⚖️ The TSE's president, Kassio Nunes Marques, denied the request by Lula's campaign for Funai, the Indigenous Health Secretariat and the Ministry of Indigenous Peoples to transport Indigenous voters in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) with a simple prior notice of the routes, and on 24/Oct the Prosecutor General, Paulo Gonet, asked the Supreme Court's president, Edson Fachin, to suspend that decision (CartaCapital, Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the campaign agenda: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 83.70% (cumulative volume USD 26.78M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 24/Oct, 17:21 BRT, rises 7.20pp against the confirmed reading of 23/Oct at 19:10 BRT, published in the previous update. BALLOT: 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLLS: ahead in forty-one of the forty-six post-vote national polls, among them CNT/MDA of 24/Oct, 46.3% to 45%; 46% to 46.5% in Colectta of 24/Oct.
fortes: He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) ahead, with 47.03% of the valid votes against Lula's 45.16%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally.
He stands at 83.70% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 24/Oct, 17:21 BRT, 67.20pp ahead of Lula.
He leads forty-one of the forty-six national polls conducted after the vote, among them 46.3% to 45% in CNT/MDA of 24/Oct and 50% to 44.9% in Vetor Arrow of 23/Oct, in total votes.
He has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Michel Temer.
Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, he has 56% against 15% in Ipespe, 54.9% against 26.9% in AtlasIntel and 57% against 19% in PoderData/Aya.
fracos: He trails in Colectta of 24/Oct, with 46% against 46.5% in total votes, and in the three Vox Brasil polls conducted after the vote, with 44.3% against 45.4% on 23/Oct, 44.6% against 46.4% on 18/Oct and 42.7% against 44.2% on 09/Oct; in Datafolha of 22/Oct, he ties at 50% of the valid votes.

⚖️ On 18/Oct, Estadão reported, and Folha de S.Paulo and G1 confirmed, that the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) (PF) took to the Supreme Court an investigation into suspected money laundering involving the lawyer Willer Tomaz, his companies and Flávio Bolsonaro, with Alexandre de Moraes drawn as rapporteur (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). On 23/Oct, Moraes authorized lifting the secrecy of the offshore company Alcazar Holdings, owned by Willer Tomaz, and ordered the freezing of up to R$ 6 billion of the lawyer's assets (Gazeta do Povo, O Globo and Folha de S.Paulo). Flávio Bolsonaro's defense says the relationship between the two is limited to a friendship between the families and calls false the reports that they shared a bank account (Gazeta do Povo). On 20/Oct, a technical note from the Finance Ministry named Willer Tomaz as the country's largest sports-betting gambler in 2025, with R$ 5 billion wagered (Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo).

⚖️ The government leader in Congress, Randolfe Rodrigues, is collecting signatures for a complaint to the Senate Ethics Council that seeks the loss of Flávio Bolsonaro's mandate for breach of decorum, citing his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro; the document has yet to be filed (Folha de S.Paulo and Valor).

🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro's arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): third place, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).
fortes: He finished third, with 2.89% of the valid votes, ahead of Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado.
The [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno)'s third-place book was resolved in his favour.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid more for Renan Santos, 47.50%, and for Ronaldo Caiado, 30.00%, than for him, 23.70%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in third, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. The first round's third-place book, which on the eve paid 23.70% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, was resolved in his favour. 🤝 On 08/Oct he declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): fourth place, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): he backs neither of the two.
fortes: He finished fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18%.
His contract in the winner book closed with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, and third place went to Augusto Cury.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book, behind Lula's. On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, and it was resolved in favour of Augusto Cury. 🤝 On the night of 04/Oct he said he backs neither of the two in the second round and freed Missão's activists to choose (Gazeta do Povo and Agência Brasil).

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema, with 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad did not run for President. PRICE: the three winner contracts were closed and resolved at zero.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally (100% of polling sections) and the closing of the winner contracts after the first round.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 2.18% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.82M cumulative.
caiado.fortes: He declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct, with governor Daniel Vilela (O Globo and VEJA).
caiado.fracos: He finished fifth, behind Renan Santos, and the PSD decided on neutrality in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
haddad.fortes: The top of his series in the winner contract was 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He was not measured by any national poll in a presidential scenario or in a second-round pairing.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 0.27% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
zema.fortes: ⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of his voters would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), the largest transfer among the names measured (O Globo).
zema.fracos: He had 0.27% of the valid votes. He declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on 05/Oct, and Novo declared support for him on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).

candidates.analise: 🗳️ Ronaldo Caiado finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fifth, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema had 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad ran for governor of São Paulo, not for President. The three contracts in the winner book were closed by Polymarket and resolved at zero. 🤝 Romeu Zema declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on the night of 05/Oct (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo), and Novo, his party, declared support on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital). Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), even with the PSD neutral in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), and Romeu Zema declared his vote for him on 05/Oct, followed by Novo on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).
⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of Romeu Zema's voters and 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (O Globo).
fracos: The two are out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and the winner contracts of all three names were resolved at zero.
Fernando Haddad did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).

Flávio Bolsonaro's defense says the relationship between the two is limited to a friendship between the families and calls false the reports that they shared a bank account (Gazeta do Povo). On 20/Oct, a technical note from the Finance Ministry named Willer Tomaz as the country's largest sports-betting gambler in 2025, with R$ 5 billion wagered (Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo). ⚖️ On 23/Oct, TSE Justice Floriano de Azevedo Marques ruled that only the full court can suspend the Exército do Lula channel on WhatsApp (Agência Brasil and Folha de S.Paulo). In a decision reported on 24/Oct, the TSE barred Nikolas Ferreira and Pablo Marçal from posting false content until the election, under a fine of R$ 100 thousand (Folha de S.Paulo), and ordered Meta and X to submit reports every six hours on the posts of the two (G1, Valor and O Globo). ⚖️ The TSE's president, Kassio Nunes Marques, denied the request by Lula's campaign for Funai, the Indigenous Health Secretariat and the Ministry of Indigenous Peoples to transport Indigenous voters in the second round with a simple prior notice of the routes, and on 24/Oct the Prosecutor General, Paulo Gonet, asked the Supreme Court's president, Edson Fachin, to suspend that decision (CartaCapital, Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo). ⚖️ On 22/Oct, Justice Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, the TSE's inspector general, denied in an injunction ruling the request by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign to suspend government messages sent via WhatsApp and Gov.br, among them notices about Bolsa Família, Farmácia Popular and the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) proof-of-life check, considering them of apparently informative content, and gave the parties five days to respond (CartaCapital, G1 and CNN Brasil). ⚖️ The government leader in Congress, Randolfe Rodrigues, is collecting signatures for a complaint to the Senate Ethics Council that seeks the loss of Flávio Bolsonaro's mandate for breach of decorum, citing his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro; the document has yet to be filed (Folha de S.Paulo and Valor). ⚖️ On 20/Oct, the Federal Police asked the Supreme Court for more time in the inquiries into alleged influence peddling by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, the president's son, and Justice Edson Fachin is to decide (Estadão and G1). 🤝 Flávio Bolsonaro has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Michel Temer and the MDB, which on 13/Oct formalized the support of 17 state branches (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo); 10 MDB branches, from the North and Northeast, declared support for Lula (Estadão, Valor and CartaCapital). PSDB stayed neutral. Lula has the support of UP, PSTU and PCB (CNN Brasil and G1). On 16/Oct, former Fortaleza mayor Roberto Cláudio declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro (G1). Renan Santos said on 15/Oct that he does not back Lula and will not vote (O Globo and Estadão). 📜 On 16/Oct Congress promulgated the constitutional amendment (PEC) ending the 6x1 work schedule, which cuts the maximum working week from 44 to 40 hours (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Valor), and Flávio Bolsonaro had said on 13/Oct that he would vote in favour (UOL and CNN Brasil). In BTG/Nexus of 19/Oct, 66.2% support ending the 6x1 schedule (UOL and Diário do Grande ABC). 📊 The national polls that still have a release scheduled with the TSE are Datafolha, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), AtlasIntel, Palver, Nexus, Datavero, Simplex and 100 Cidades, for 24/Oct, and PoderData, for 25/Oct. ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to the polls, the debate, the inquiries or the day's acts: it measures the sides with each one's timestamps.
